description: Data-driven rubric v2, derived from 3,972 comments across 49 nuri-com repos (411 PRs, 646 issues, 1,707 inline comments, 752 general comments, 1,384 PR reviews, 293 issue comments). Weights are proportional to comment frequency with a minimum floor for catastrophic-but-rare categories (security). The top 2 categories (race_condition 12.5%, stale_state 9.4%) were ABSENT from rubric v1.

race_condition.description: Async operations without cancellation, in-flight leaks, missing cleanup on unmount, floating promises, concurrent access without ordering guarantees. The #1 most common issue in the codebase.

rules.name: Missing cleanup in useEffect
rules.description: useEffect with empty dependency array that references state or props — the closure captures mount-time values. Check if the effect reads variables not in the deps array.

rules.name: Floating promise (void async call)
rules.description: Using `void` before an async call creates a floating promise — if it rejects, the error is swallowed and the operation can't be cancelled.

rules.name: Async operation without cancellation
rules.description: Async operations (fetch, subscriptions, timers) started in useEffect or event handlers must have cancellation logic. Without it, in-flight requests leak and stale responses can overwrite fresh state.

rules.name: Missing AbortController for fetch
rules.description: Fetch calls in React components should use AbortController to cancel on unmount. Without it, responses arriving after unmount cause state updates on unmounted components.

rules.name: Concurrent state mutation
rules.description: Multiple async operations writing to the same state without ordering guarantees. Use mutex, queue, or atomic updates to prevent interleaving.

stale_state.description: Cached data read after an async gap without revalidation. useEffect closures capturing stale values. Ghost balances. The #2 most common issue.

rules.name: useEffect reads state not in dependency array
rules.description: useEffect that reads state variables but doesn't list them in the dependency array. The closure captures the mount-time value, causing stale reads.

rules.name: Cached data used after async gap
rules.description: Data fetched or computed before an await is used after the await without revalidation. The data may be stale if state changed during the async gap.

rules.name: Ghost balance display
rules.description: Balance or amount displayed from cached state without checking if a more recent update is available. Users see incorrect balances.

rules.name: Missing refetch on focus/reconnect
rules.description: Data that can change server-side (balances, transaction status) should be refetched on app focus or network reconnect.

ui_component.description: Screen layout, component structure, modal behavior, navigation issues.

rules.name: Modal layer isolation
rules.description: Modals and overlay layers must isolate content — accessibilityViewIsModal, aria-hidden on background, pointerEvents on layers.

rules.name: Back handler on layers
rules.description: Hardware back button must be consumed by visible layers to prevent back falling through to content behind blocking layers.

rules.name: Component prop correctness
rules.description: Components must receive correct props — wrong types, missing required props, or incorrect conditional rendering.

architecture.description: Code structure, separation of concerns, module boundaries, dependency management.

rules.name: Circular dependency
rules.description: Modules that import each other create circular dependencies that cause runtime errors or initialization order issues.

rules.name: Separation of concerns
rules.description: Business logic mixed with UI rendering, or crypto operations in view components. Extract into hooks or services.

rules.name: Module structure
rules.description: Files should have a single responsibility. Mixing unrelated functionality in one file makes the codebase harder to navigate.

code_style.description: Lint compliance, formatting, import ordering, naming conventions.

rules.name: ESLint compliance
rules.description: Code should pass eslint with the project's configured ruleset.

rules.name: Import ordering
rules.description: Imports should be ordered and grouped consistently (stdlib, external, internal, relative).

security_crypto.description: Cryptographic correctness, key handling, attack surface. Weight is higher than frequency because a single crypto mistake is catastrophic in a wallet.

rules.name: No private keys in localStorage
rules.description: Persisting private keys, seeds, mnemonics, or credentials in localStorage breaks the security boundary.

rules.name: No hardcoded secrets
rules.description: Hardcoded secrets, API keys, or operator details must never be committed.

rules.name: No Math.random for crypto
rules.description: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure. Use crypto.getRandomValues().

rules.name: No eval or Function constructor
rules.description: eval() and new Function() execute arbitrary strings as code.

rules.name: No innerHTML with dynamic content
rules.description: Setting innerHTML with dynamic content enables XSS.

rules.name: No insecure HTTP for sensitive endpoints
rules.description: Sensitive API calls must use HTTPS.

rules.name: Signature verification
rules.description: All signature verification and assertion validation must be performed correctly.

rules.name: No nonce reuse
rules.description: Cryptographic nonces must never be reused. In MuSig2, nonce reuse leaks private keys.

rules.name: Sandbox WebView/iframe content
rules.description: WebView and iframe content must be sandboxed by default.

rules.name: Missing zeroization of sensitive data
rules.description: Sensitive Uint8Array (seeds, keys, nonces) must be wiped after use. Leaving them in memory increases exposure window.

ota_native_boundary.description: OTA updates cannot change native modules. Code that calls native modules not present in the current binary must be gated or have fallbacks.

rules.name: Native module call in OTA-shippable code
rules.description: OTA updates cannot change native modules. Code that calls native modules not present in the current binary must be gated or have fallbacks.

rules.name: Fingerprint compatibility check
rules.description: Code must check the binary fingerprint before calling native APIs that may not exist in older versions.

error_handling.description: Error propagation, rethrowing, error boundaries, non-transient failure handling.

rules.name: No silent catch blocks
rules.description: Empty catch blocks swallow errors silently. At minimum, log the error.

rules.name: Error propagation
rules.description: Errors from critical operations must be propagated to the caller or surfaced to the user, not swallowed.

rules.name: Non-transient failure handling
rules.description: Non-transient failures (e.g., invalid input, permission denied) must not be retried indefinitely. Distinguish from transient failures (network timeout).

data_integrity.description: Address source consistency, no silent downgrades, stale armed results, fatal operations, deduplication.

rules.name: Unify address sources
rules.description: When multiple integrations need a default address, they must use a unified source. Divergent sources cause funds to be sent to wrong addresses.

rules.name: No silent storage downgrade
rules.description: Storage operations must not silently downgrade from persistent to volatile.

rules.name: Clear stale armed results
rules.description: Starting a new async operation must clear stale results from previous runs.

rules.name: Make failed critical operations fatal
rules.description: Critical operations like IBAN moves must be fatal on failure.

rules.name: Deduplicate sync requests
rules.description: Repeated sync requests must be deduplicated to prevent duplicate state writes.

timeout_retry.description: Timeout handling, backoff strategies, retry logic, transient vs non-transient failures.

rules.name: Preserve timeout backoff on failures
rules.description: When boarding reads fail, the timeout backoff must be preserved, not reset. Resetting causes retry storms.

rules.name: Re-throw non-transient failures
rules.description: Non-transient boarding failures must be re-thrown, not swallowed or treated as transient.

dead_code.description: Unused imports, unreachable branches, orphaned code, duplicate logic.

rules.name: No dead code or unused imports
rules.description: Unused imports and dead code should be removed.

rules.name: No unreachable branches
rules.description: Code after unconditional returns or throws is unreachable.

silent_catch.description: Empty catch blocks, void on promises, ignored errors. NOTE: ERR-001 in error_handling already checks for empty catch blocks with the same regex. CATCH-001 is moved to LLM to avoid double-penalizing. CATCH-002 (void on promises) is a distinct check.

rules.name: Silent catch (LLM check for context)
rules.description: Empty catch blocks that swallow errors. The static check is in error_handling/ERR-001. This LLM rule catches cases where the catch block has code but still swallows errors (e.g., catch but only logs, doesn't propagate).

rules.name: No void on rejecting promises
rules.description: Using `void` before a function that returns a promise swallows rejections.

accessibility.description: Missing aria, blocked zoom, removed focus states, keyboard navigation.

rules.name: Visible focus state
rules.description: Removing :focus and :focus-visible outlines leaves keyboard users without navigation indicators.

rules.name: Don't disable browser zoom
rules.description: Disabling browser zoom violates WCAG 1.4.4.

rules.name: ARIA labels on interactive elements
rules.description: Interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) need accessible names via aria-label or visible text.

documentation.description: Missing docs, missing inline comments, markdownlint violations.

rules.name: Label code fences in docs
rules.description: Code fences in markdown should have a language label.

rules.name: Document complex logic
rules.description: Complex logic, crypto operations, and state machines need inline comments explaining the why.

missing_validation.description: Missing runtime type checks at external boundaries, unvalidated user input.

rules.name: Runtime validation at external boundaries
rules.description: Data from external sources (API responses, user input, IPC) must be validated at the boundary before use.

rules.name: Per-item validation in arrays
rules.description: Arrays from external sources must have per-item validation, not just type checks on the array itself.

webview_sandbox.description: Sandbox attributes, CSP headers, origin restrictions on WebView and iframe.

rules.name: Sandbox iframe content
rules.description: WebView and iframe content must be sandboxed by default with appropriate sandbox attributes.

rules.name: Content Security Policy
rules.description: CSP headers must restrict script sources and prevent inline script execution.

state_management.description: State synchronization, batch updates, context provider issues, infinite loops.

rules.name: No recursive resolveRequest
rules.description: Calling context.resolveRequest recursively inside a custom resolveRequest causes infinite loops (Maximum call stack size exceeded).

rules.name: State synchronization
rules.description: Multiple state sources (local state, context, server) must be synchronized to prevent inconsistent UI.

performance.description: Unnecessary initialization, memory leaks, render optimization, bundle size.

rules.name: Don't initialize expensive resources on every call
rules.description: Expensive initializations should be cached or lazy-loaded.

rules.name: No memory leaks in event listeners
rules.description: Event listeners must be cleaned up in useEffect return.

rules.name: Clear naming
rules.description: Names should be descriptive and not misleading.

preserve_behavior.description: Preserving existing behavior when refactoring, avoiding breaking changes.

rules.name: Don't break existing behavior
rules.description: Refactors must preserve existing behavior. Don't close sends before a tx is submitted, don't remove fallback paths without replacement.

balance_sync.description: Balance display mismatches, stale balance updates.

rules.name: Balance display matches actual state
rules.description: Displayed balance must match the actual on-chain/server state. Stale balances cause users to make incorrect decisions.

type_safety.description: Type casts, enum correctness, TypeScript strictness.

rules.name: No unsafe type casts
rules.description: Avoid `as any` and unsafe type casts. Use proper type guards.

rules.name: Correct enum usage
rules.description: Enum values must match the actual library API. Example: BIOMETRIC_STRONG doesn't exist in expo-local-authentication.

user_verification.description: Missing user verification (UV) on passkey operations, biometric prompt issues.

rules.name: User verification on passkey operations
rules.description: Passkey signing operations must require user verification (UV). Missing UV allows signing without biometric/PIN.

api_correctness.description: Wrong API usage, missing interfaces, incorrect HTTP attributes.

rules.name: Implement required interfaces
rules.description: WebView shims must implement all required interfaces like injectedJavaScriptObject. Missing interfaces cause runtime crashes.

rules.name: Handle URL objects in interceptors
rules.description: Fetch and XMLHttpRequest interceptors must handle URL objects, not just strings.

rules.name: Correct HTML attributes
rules.description: In raw HTML files, use http-equiv not camelCase React JSX props.

incomplete_cleanup.description: Incomplete wipes, orphaned entries, partial sweeps.

rules.name: Complete keychain wipe
rules.description: wipeAllKeychainData must remove ALL aliased entries, not just the primary key.

rules.name: Sweep all items, not just first
rules.description: Sweep operations must process all items, not just the first match.

localstorage_secret.description: Keys, seeds, or credentials in localStorage. Rare but catastrophic. Hard gate because even one instance is unacceptable. NOTE: SEC-001 in security_crypto already checks this with the same regex — this category exists as a separate hard gate to ensure the penalty is applied even if security_crypto weight is reduced.

rules.name: No private keys in localStorage (duplicate hard gate)
rules.description: Duplicate of SEC-001 — kept as LLM rule to avoid double-penalizing with the same regex. The static check is in security_crypto/SEC-001. This LLM rule catches cases the regex misses (e.g., indirect localStorage access via wrapper functions).

scoring.description: Each category scored 0-100. Final = weighted sum. Hard gate categories with critical violations get score 0. Below pass_threshold = reject.
